subject: general
question: In which country or state of India is Tengboche Monastery located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tengboche Monastery **o**r Thyangboche Monastery** is also known as** Dawa Choling Gompa.**
 
• It is situated in Tengboche village in Khumjung in the Khumbu region of eastern Nepal.
 
• **It is a Tibetan Buddhist monastery of the Sherpa community.**
 
• It was established by Lama Gulu in 1916 and was destroyed by an earthquake in **1934 **but was subsequently rebuilt.
 
• Tragedy befell the monastery again when it was engulfed by fire in **1989**.
 
• **However, It was again re-established with the help of devoted volunteers from the area and with international assistance.**
 
• The resulting structure is a great work of stone masonry on display, complete with an extended courtyard and spacious halls.
 
• It facilitates religious rites and activities.
 
• Also located within its vicinity is a nunnery as Vajrayana Buddhism which does not distinguish between genders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Heritage in its own right, Tengboche Monastery falls within the Sagarmatha National Park which is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site.**
 
• This region is home to a wide range of Himalayan floras and faunas.
 
• Tengboche also forms the end point of the** “Sacred Sites Trail Project” a circular trek inside the park.**
 
• It passes clockwise through ten monasteries, caves, Hermitages, and Nunneries, starting from Namche Bazaar and ending at Tengboche Monastery.
